wins: Mapped 3 live hosts via aggressive nmap scan (nmap -Pn -sC -sV -p- 10.0.0.5/24) and cataloged open services
Captured SSH banner for future credential brute force stage by targeting port 22 on 10.0.5.12
Documented high-value ports (22/80/443) for prioritized follow-on actions
fails: Failed to achieve persistence due to absence of valid credentials after eight brute force attempts
Repeated mentor calls triggered before exploitation phase stabilized, indicating insufficient automated follow-up planning
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance succeeded in quickly identifying high-value hosts and services, but the run stalled at exploitation due to credential and persistence gaps.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Brute force attempts on SSH without credential validation feedback

skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When web server on 10.0.0.5 responds with HTTP 200
skill_cards.then_action: Run HTTP enumeration with gobuster and nikto

skill_cards.if_condition: When nmap service scan shows Apache 2.4
skill_cards.then_action: Search for known CVEs and test with nikto nikto + manual request

Consistent discovery of additional HTTP directories
